  "pros": [
    "Intuitive drag-and-drop interface made creating posters simple.",
    "Wide selection of templates and design elements specifically useful for academic presentations.",
    "Allowed for quick production of visually appealing college presentation posters."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Advanced customization options sometimes felt limited compared to professional design tools.",
    "Required a stable internet connection to access all features and assets.",
    "Some unique design elements were locked behind a premium subscription."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This student found Canva to be an incredibly helpful tool for their academic task of creating college presentation posters. The platform's ease of use and extensive template library allowed them to produce high-quality visuals efficiently. While they appreciated its accessibility, some advanced design needs or premium feature limitations occasionally arose."
